entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Hakob Paronyan State Musical Comedy Theatre, founded in 1941, is one of the prominent theatres of the Armenian capital Yerevan. It is located on Vazgen Sargsyan Street in the central Kentron district of the city, near the Republic Square. It is named after the renowned Armenian satirist Hagop Baronian.
